name.description: The native app's project name, in angular.json and as the Expo slug.

directory.description: Where the project goes. Defaults to newProjectRoot/name, usually projects/native.

bundleIdentifier.description: The iOS bundle identifier and Android package: com.acme.mobile. Defaults to com.<workspace scope>.<name>.

linter.description: eslint adds an eslint.config.mjs with @ng-native/eslint-plugin's recommended rules, its dependencies and a lint target.

skipInstall.description: Write the files and package.json without installing.
